verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh ships its own AI agents for screening and transaction monitoring, so a buyer could fairly ask whether those agents can consume external MCP servers. That makes the axis applicable. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of any MCP client capability or any mechanism for registering external tool servers. The llms.txt file and the OpenAPI schema are documentation-retrieval aids, not MCP client support, so they earn no credit.
